mil5.2.7:1.2: Tathāgatassa kho Ānanda na evaṃ hoti: ahaṃ bhikkhusanghaṃ pariharissāmīti vā, mamuddesiko bhikkhusangho ti vā ti.
mil5.2.7:1.3: Puna ca Metteyyassa bhagavato sabhāvaguṇaṃ paridīpayamānena evaṃ bhaṇitaṃ:
mil5.2.7:1.4: So anekasahassaṃ bhikkhusanghaṃ pariharissati seyyathā pi ahaṃ etarahi anekasataṃ bhikkhusanghaṃ pariharāmīti.
mil5.2.7:1.6: Tathāgatassa kho Ānanda na evaṃ hoti: ahaṃ bhikkhusanghaṃ pariharāmīti vā, mamuddesiko bhikkhusangho ti vā ti, tena hi: anekasataṃ bhikkhusanghaṃ pariharāmīti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.2.7:1.8: seyyathā pi ahaṃ etarahi anekasataṃ bhikkhusanghaṃ pariharāmīti, tena hi: Tathāgatassa kho Ānanda na evaṃ hoti: ahaṃ bhikkhusanghaṃ pariharāmīti vā, mamuddesiko bhikkhusangho ti vā ti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā. Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.2.7:2.1: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā: Tathāgatassa kho Ānanda na evaṃ hoti: ahaṃ bhikkhusanghaṃ pariharāmīti vā, mamuddesiko bhikkhusangho ti vā ti.
mil5.2.7:2.2: Metteyyassāpi bhagavato sabhāvaguṇaṃ paridīpayamānena Bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ:
mil5.2.7:2.3: So anekasahassaṃ bhikkhusanghaṃ pariharissati seyyathā pi ahaṃ etarahi anekasataṃ bhikkhusanghaṃ pariharāmīti.
mil5.2.7:2.4: Etasmiñ-ca mahārāja pañhe eko attho sāvaseso, eko attho niravaseso.
mil5.2.7:2.5: Na mahārāja Tathāgato parisāya anugāmiko, parisā pana Tathāgatassa anugāmikā.
mil5.2.7:2.6: Sammuti mahārāja esā: ahan-ti, mamāti, na paramattho eso. Vigataṃ mahārāja Tathāgatassa pemaṃ, vigato sineho, mayhan-ti pi Tathāgatassa gahaṇaṃ natthi, upādāya pana avassayo hoti.
mil5.2.7:3.1: Yathā mahārāja paṭhavī bhummaṭṭhānaṃ sattānaṃ patiṭṭhā hoti upassayaṃ hoti, paṭhaviṭṭhā c' ete sattā, na ca mahāpaṭhaviyā: mayh' ete ti apekkhā hoti;
mil5.2.7:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja Tathāgato sabbasattānaṃ patiṭṭhā hoti upassayaṃ, Tathāgataṭṭhā c' ete sattā, na ca Tathāgatassa: mayh' ete ti apekkhā hoti.
mil5.2.7:3.3: Yathā vā pana mahatimahāmegho abhivassanto tiṇarukkha-pasu-manussānaṃ vuddhiṃ deti santatim-anupāleti,
mil5.2.7:3.4: vuṭṭhūpajīvino c' ete sattā sabbe, na ca mahāmeghassa: mayh' ete ti apekkhā hoti;
mil5.2.7:3.5: evam-eva kho mahārāja Tathāgato sabbasattānaṃ kusaladhamme janeti anupāleti, Satthūpajīvino c' ete sattā sabbe, na ca Tathāgatassa: mayh' ete ti apekkhā hoti;
mil5.2.7:4.1: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, sunibbeṭhito pañho bahuvidhehi kāraṇehi, gambhīro uttānīkato, gaṇṭhi bhinno, gahanaṃ agahanaṃ kataṃ, andhakāro āloko kato, bhaggā parappavādā, Jinaputtānaṃ cakkhuṃ uppāditan-
